[016_the_initial_idea_of_making_a_suicide_attempt] Reasons for the near-lethal suicide attempt
[page/7/Text/11] Prisoners discussed a wide variety of different reasons for their act of self-harm. These were grouped into three categories: adverse life events; criminal justice or prison-related issues; and psychiatric and psychological factors (Table 1).
